title: Schockanrufe in russischer Sprache – hohe Schadenssummen in sehr kurzer Zeit

extraction.summaryEn: Since January 2026, about 20 shock calls in Russian targeting elderly Berliners have caused roughly 400,000 euros in damage. In one case on 23 February, an 84-year-old in Spandau handed over money to a courier posing as a police officer's contact.
